# Data contracts of the genomics-showcase pack

One section per command of the pack: the shape of its data, how it is stored and checked, and what a person still has to confirm. The rules every contract shares are in [the contracts README](../README.md); the index of every command is [packs/README.md](README.md). The pack's README, [modules/genomics/packs/genomics-showcase/README.md](../../../modules/genomics/packs/genomics-showcase/README.md), links each kind here and to its example (tools/packgen/common/guide_data.py) next to where each kind's data comes from (*Data retrieval*).

| [SGENE](#sgene-study-gene-study-gene) | `study-gene` | fundamental | active | 11 | 0 |
| [SSAMPLE](#ssample-study-sample-study-sample) | `study-sample` | fundamental | active | 12 | 0 |

## SGENE: Study gene (`study-gene`)

One gene of the synthetic genome: where it sits, what it does, how long its protein is and how many samples of the cohort carry a damaging change in it. 24 of the 2,000 genes are the planted drivers, led by HLXK7.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Contract | [study-gene.contract.yaml](../../../modules/genomics/packs/genomics-showcase/contracts/study-gene.contract.yaml) · version 1.0 |
| Class | fundamental |
| Status | active |
| Source | synthetic: the seeded generator tools/packgen/genomics_showcase/make.py (nothing real: the genes, patients, protein and designs are invented) |
| Grain | One row per gene, keyed by GENE. |
| Key | `GENE` |
| Id pattern | — |
| Dated by | `snapshot` |
| Cadence | static (due: regenerated only when the generator or its seed changes; the same documents on every business day) |
| Binding hint | lake table `genomics-showcase.study-gene`; the site binds it (`config/bindings.yaml`, Admin → Data bindings) |
| Columns | `GENE`, `CHROM`, `START`, `END`, `ROLE`, `PROTEIN_LENGTH`, `DRIVER`, `ALTERED_SAMPLES` |
| Test data | data/testdata/genomics-showcase/study-gene |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GENE` | id | required |  | The gene's invented symbol (HLX followed by letters and digits). | `HLXK7` |  |
| `CHROM` | text | required |  | The chromosome: 1 to 22 or X. | `7` |  |
| `START` | integer | required | bp | The first base of the gene on its chromosome. | `61864222` |  |
| `END` | integer | required | bp | The last base of the gene on its chromosome. | `61917398` |  |
| `STRAND` | text | required |  | The strand the gene is read from. | `+`, `-` |  |
| `ROLE` | text | required |  | What the gene's product does. | `kinase (drug target)` |  |
| `PROTEIN_LENGTH` | integer | required | amino acids | The amino acids of its protein: the axis of the variant lollipop. | `312` |  |
| `DRIVER` | boolean | required |  | True for the 24 driver genes whose alterations the generator plants in the cohort. | `True` |  |
| `VARIANTS` | integer | required | sites | How many variant sites the gene has. Source: counted from study-variant. | `220` |  |
| `ALTERED_SAMPLES` | integer | required | samples | How many samples carry a damaging change (high or moderate impact) in the gene. Source: counted from variant-call. | `598` |  |
| `ALTERED_FRACTION` | rate | required | fraction | ALTERED_SAMPLES over the cohort's 1,500 samples. | `0.3987` |  |

**Validation**

- required: fields `GENE`, `CHROM`, `START`, `END`, `STRAND`, `ROLE`, `PROTEIN_LENGTH`, `DRIVER`, `VARIANTS`, `ALTERED_SAMPLES`, `ALTERED_FRACTION`
- unique: key `GENE`; per snapshot
- enum: field STRAND; values `+`, `-`

**Notes**

- Synthetic and seeded: the same seed gives the same documents, byte for byte. Nothing in it is real: the gene, protein, patients and designs are invented, and every screen that shows it says so.
- A snapshot: the same documents on every business day of the demo lake.

## SVARIANT: Study variant (`study-variant`)

One variant site of the synthetic genome: its place, the change it makes to the gene's protein (the amino acids before and after, the key into the protein workbench's scan) and how many samples carry it.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Contract | [study-variant.contract.yaml](../../../modules/genomics/packs/genomics-showcase/contracts/study-variant.contract.yaml) · version 1.0 |
| Class | fundamental |
| Status | active |
| Source | synthetic: the seeded generator tools/packgen/genomics_showcase/make.py (nothing real: the genes, patients, protein and designs are invented) |
| Grain | One row per variant site, keyed by VARIANT_ID. |
| Key | `VARIANT_ID` |
| Id pattern | `^HX-` |
| Dated by | `snapshot` |
| Cadence | static (due: regenerated only when the generator or its seed changes; the same documents on every business day) |
| Binding hint | lake table `genomics-showcase.study-variant`; the site binds it (`config/bindings.yaml`, Admin → Data bindings) |
| Columns | `VARIANT_ID`, `GENE`, `CHROM`, `POS`, `CONSEQUENCE`, `IMPACT`, `PROTEIN_POS`, `CARRIERS` |
| Test data | data/testdata/genomics-showcase/study-variant |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `VARIANT_ID` | id | required |  | HX- and six digits, in genome order. | `HX-004711` |  |
| `CHROM` | text | required |  | The chromosome. | `7` |  |
| `POS` | integer | required | bp | The base the variant is at. | `61887913` |  |
| `REF` | text | required |  | The base the reference has there. | `G` |  |
| `ALT` | text | required |  | The base the variant has there. | `A` |  |
| `GENE` | id | required |  | The gene the variant lies in; opens SGENE. | `HLXK7` | `study-gene` |
| `CONSEQUENCE` | text | required |  | What the change does to the gene's product. | `missense_variant`, `synonymous_variant`, `stop_gained`, `frameshift_variant`, `splice_region_variant`, `intron_variant` |  |
| `IMPACT` | text | required |  | How much the change matters: HIGH, MODERATE, LOW or MODIFIER. | `HIGH`, `MODERATE`, `LOW`, `MODIFIER` |  |
| `PROTEIN_POS` | integer | optional |  | The amino acid position in the protein; empty for a change outside the coding sequence. | `117` |  |
| `AA_REF` | text | optional |  | The amino acid before the change (one letter); empty outside the coding sequence. | `L` |  |
| `AA_ALT` | text | optional |  | The amino acid after the change (one letter, * for a stop, - for a frameshift); empty outside the coding sequence. With the gene and PROTEIN_POS it is the key into dms-score (PROTEIN, POS, AA). | `P` |  |
| `CARRIERS` | integer | required | samples | How many samples carry the variant. Source: counted from variant-call. | `372` |  |

**Links:** `GENE` → `study-gene`.

**Validation**

- required: fields `VARIANT_ID`, `CHROM`, `POS`, `REF`, `ALT`, `GENE`, `CONSEQUENCE`, `IMPACT`, `CARRIERS`
- unique: key `VARIANT_ID`; per snapshot
- link: field GENE; kind study-gene
- enum: field CONSEQUENCE; values `missense_variant`, `synonymous_variant`, `stop_gained`, `frameshift_variant`, `splice_region_variant`, `intron_variant`
- enum: field IMPACT; values `HIGH`, `MODERATE`, `LOW`, `MODIFIER`

**Notes**

- Synthetic and seeded: the same seed gives the same documents, byte for byte. Nothing in it is real: the gene, protein, patients and designs are invented, and every screen that shows it says so.
- A snapshot: the same documents on every business day of the demo lake.

## VCALL: Variant call (`variant-call`)

## ASSOC: Association of a variant with a trait (`association`)

One variant tested against one trait: the p-value, its negative log, the effect and its error and how strongly the variant is linked to the peak's lead. Three traits over 12,000 sites: 36,000 tests, each computed from the calls and the samples' traits (a Wald test on the log odds ratio), never painted.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Contract | [association.contract.yaml](../../../modules/genomics/packs/genomics-showcase/contracts/association.contract.yaml) · version 1.0 |
| Class | fundamental |
| Status | active |
| Source | synthetic: the seeded generator tools/packgen/genomics_showcase/make.py (nothing real: the genes, patients, protein and designs are invented) |
| Grain | One row per trait and variant, keyed by ASSOC_ID. |
| Key | `ASSOC_ID` |
| Id pattern | `^GWAS-` |
| Dated by | `snapshot` |
| Cadence | static (due: regenerated only when the generator or its seed changes; the same documents on every business day) |
| Binding hint | lake table `genomics-showcase.association`; the site binds it (`config/bindings.yaml`, Admin → Data bindings) |
| Columns | `TRAIT`, `CHROM`, `VARIANT_ID`, `GENE`, `NEG_LOG10_P`, `BETA` |
| Test data | data/testdata/genomics-showcase/association |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ASSOC_ID` | id | required |  | GWAS-, the trait, - and the variant's id. | `GWAS-RESPONSE-HX-004711` |  |
| `TRAIT` | text | required |  | The trait tested: RESPONSE (responder), TOXICITY (severe) or RELAPSE (relapsed). | `RESPONSE`, `TOXICITY`, `RELAPSE` |  |
| `VARIANT_ID` | id | required |  | The variant tested; opens SVARIANT. | `HX-004711` | `study-variant` |
| `CHROM` | text | required |  | The variant's chromosome. | `7` |  |
| `POS` | integer | required | bp | The variant's base on it. | `61887913` |  |
| `GENE` | id | required |  | The gene the variant lies in; opens SGENE. | `HLXK7` | `study-gene` |
| `P` | amount | required |  | The two-sided p-value of the test; 1 where no sample carries the variant. | `1.2e-23` |  |
| `NEG_LOG10_P` | amount | required |  | Minus the base-10 logarithm of P: the height on the association plot. | `22.92` |  |
| `BETA` | amount | optional |  | The log odds ratio of the trait for a carrier against a non-carrier (0.5 added to each cell); empty without carriers. | `-1.84` |  |
| `SE` | amount | optional |  | The standard error of BETA; empty without carriers. | `0.19` |  |
| `R2_LEAD` | amount | required |  | The squared correlation of the variant's carriers with the carriers of the lead variant of the peak it lies in (within 2 Mb); 0 outside a peak. | `0.82` |  |

**Links:** `VARIANT_ID` → `study-variant`, `GENE` → `study-gene`.

**Validation**

- required: fields `ASSOC_ID`, `TRAIT`, `VARIANT_ID`, `CHROM`, `POS`, `GENE`, `P`, `NEG_LOG10_P`, `R2_LEAD`
- unique: key `ASSOC_ID`; per snapshot
- enum: field TRAIT; values `RESPONSE`, `TOXICITY`, `RELAPSE`
- link: field VARIANT_ID; kind study-variant
- link: field GENE; kind study-gene

**Notes**

- Synthetic and seeded: the same seed gives the same documents, byte for byte. Nothing in it is real: the gene, protein, patients and designs are invented, and every screen that shows it says so.
- A snapshot: the same documents on every business day of the demo lake.

## CNV: Copy-number segment (`cnv-segment`)

A real record, the most complete of the first rows (the one with the most non-empty fields), two-space indents. A string such as `"… 506 more numbers"` inside an array marks a fold: it stands for the elements left out and is not part of the data.

```json
{
  "SEGMENT_ID": "CNV-00009",
  "SAMPLE_ID": "S0006",
  "CHROM": "3",
  "START": 131403609,
  "END": 132394433,
  "COPY_NUMBER": 5,
  "CALL": "amplification",
  "GENE": "HLXR3"
}
```

## PATHWAY: Pathway membership (`pathway-gene`)

One gene in one biological pathway and the part it plays there. Twelve invented pathways, 500 memberships.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Contract | [pathway-gene.contract.yaml](../../../modules/genomics/packs/genomics-showcase/contracts/pathway-gene.contract.yaml) · version 1.0 |
| Class | fundamental |
| Status | active |
| Source | synthetic: the seeded generator tools/packgen/genomics_showcase/make.py (nothing real: the genes, patients, protein and designs are invented) |
| Grain | One row per pathway and gene, keyed by PATHWAY_GENE_ID. |
| Key | `PATHWAY_GENE_ID` |
| Id pattern | `^PWG-` |
| Dated by | `snapshot` |
| Cadence | static (due: regenerated only when the generator or its seed changes; the same documents on every business day) |
| Binding hint | lake table `genomics-showcase.pathway-gene`; the site binds it (`config/bindings.yaml`, Admin → Data bindings) |
| Columns | `PATHWAY_GENE_ID`, `PATHWAY`, `GENE`, `ROLE_IN_PATHWAY` |
| Test data | data/testdata/genomics-showcase/pathway-gene |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PATHWAY_GENE_ID` | id | required |  | PWG- and four digits. | `PWG-0007` |  |
| `PATHWAY` | text | required |  | The pathway's name. | `Growth signalling` |  |
| `GENE` | id | required |  | The member gene; opens SGENE. | `HLXK7` | `study-gene` |
| `ROLE_IN_PATHWAY` | text | required |  | The part the gene plays in the pathway. | `activator`, `inhibitor`, `scaffold`, `effector`, `regulator` |  |

**Links:** `GENE` → `study-gene`.

**Validation**

- required: fields `PATHWAY_GENE_ID`, `PATHWAY`, `GENE`, `ROLE_IN_PATHWAY`
- unique: key `PATHWAY_GENE_ID`; per snapshot
- link: field GENE; kind study-gene
- enum: field ROLE_IN_PATHWAY; values `activator`, `inhibitor`, `scaffold`, `effector`, `regulator`

**Notes**

- Synthetic and seeded: the same seed gives the same documents, byte for byte. Nothing in it is real: the gene, protein, patients and designs are invented, and every screen that shows it says so.
- A snapshot: the same documents on every business day of the demo lake.
